review_state: two-face photo route links D34.2 through R33-left gap joint to D34.6; exact .009 source keeps those nodes separated by C5
solder_observation: The corrected D34 seven-contact registration places physical pin 2 on the solder joint near (1055,2001). An exposed, continuous short B.Cu strip runs east from that joint to the distinct solder joint near (1110,2007). The latter matches the front R33-left gap joint within the established local face-map tolerance.
front_observation: The front R33-left gap joint near (3098,2345) follows continuous exposed F.Cu downward and right into the sixth contact of D34's notch-up left row near (3155,2570), physical pin 6. The May owner photo independently shows the R33-left branch entering the same gap, but only the July overhead view resolves the pin index.
front_gap_cut_inspection: A native-resolution crop of July component image PXL_20260710_200418174.jpg at (2900,1980)-(3420,2630) shows the exposed R33-left trace, the two nearby bare annuli, and the separate open XTAL16M annulus. There is no visible cut or added wire on the exposed front segment from the R33-left gap joint toward D34.6. This does not inspect copper hidden by D34 or establish the original C5 through-hole pair.
source_disagreement: Both the retained .006 scan and exact .009 sheet 2 draw D34.6/C5.1 separately from C5.2/D34.2/R33.1. The owner photos instead show a two-face copper path D34.2 -> gap joint -> D34.6 while no separate C5 body is visible on May or July dates. A target-board modification, original copper variant, or local damage remains possible; the archives do not establish factory intent.
decision: Treat the two-face D34.2-to-D34.6 copper path as photo-supported on this owner board. Keep the exact .009 source model's two nodes separate and both passives on circuit review until powered-off continuity proves the board path and the C5 site is inspected. Do not install C5 or merge nets solely because the photo path is visible.
next_inspection: Power off: measure D34.2 to D34.6 directly in both meter polarities, then measure each to R33-left gap joint and R33 right. Inspect the C5 site for a cut, jumper, or removed capacitor and compare with any other original .009 PCB before choosing the replica circuit.
older_revision_comparison: Retained .006 sheet-2 scan crop (900,100)-(2100,750) independently draws D34.6 to C5=560, the opposite C5 plate to D34.2/R33=620, and R33 to ground. The exact .009 photo prints the same component values and topology. No archived schematic revision among these two documents explains the owner-board photo bridge.

assembly_and_change_record_review.assembly_observation: The .009 assembly placement explicitly labels C5 between R33 and D34/D39, alongside C82. The owner component photos show R33 but no distinct C5 body at that position.
assembly_and_change_record_review.change_record_observation: The retained change-registration sheet lists revision numbers, document identifiers and dates, not the contents of those change documents. The assembly drawing and transcribed wire/cable table contain no explicit C5 omission or D34.2-to-D34.6 bridge instruction. This limited search cannot rule out an unarchived change document or owner modification.
assembly_and_change_record_review.decision: No archived assembly or change-list instruction resolves the source-versus-owner disagreement; retain circuit-review status and the powered-off continuity request.
